provenance: Hand-built synthetic efficiency-fit points (E7-fit); no laboratory or evaluated-library data. Efficiencies are closed-form evaluations of the E7 log-polynomial form at small round energies: fit==1 uses coeff [-2.0, -0.8, -0.05] (eff = exp(sum a_i (ln E)^i)), fit==2 uses coeff [0.5, -1.0] (eff = exp(sum a_i (1/E)^i)), computed once in float64. Any positive weights recover the coefficients exactly since every point sits on its curve; the fit==1 case carries non-uniform weights to pin the caller-weights path. Gates refit and require recovery within 1e-9 plus round-trip re-evaluation within 1e-9.
